🔴 A 42-year-old Palestinian man was killed Friday by Israeli forces near the village of Dura al-Qara, north of Ramallah in the West Bank, the Palestinian Ministry of Health reported. 📍 The official Wafa news agency reported that a security guard from a nearby settlement opened fire in the vicinity of the village. Another person was wounded, though their condition was not immediately known. ⚰️ The Ministry of Health reported that the Israeli Army is holding the body without providing details about the incident. 📊 With this case, the number of Palestinians killed so far this year by Israeli attacks in the West Bank has risen to at least 100, and to 1,158 since October 7, 2023, according to OCHA.
